description: Seed baseline for the NIAH (needle-in-haystack) regression detector. Contains the empty-results snapshot that all future runs will be compared against. Pass rates are 0.0 because no NIAH run has been recorded in this checkout yet; the seed exists so the doctor can load a well-formed baseline envelope from day one and so the regression comparator has a reference point when the first real run lands. Do not delete — only supersede with a dated snapshot under research/baselines/niah_baseline.<YYYYMMDD>.json.

regress_rules.notes: Thresholds match the policy in scripts/niah_benchmark.py: a regression is flagged when (a) any mode's overall pass_rate drops by >=0.10 vs baseline, OR (b) decode throughput drops by >=20%, OR (c) RSS growth exceeds the absolute ceiling. All thresholds are intentionally conservative for the seed; tighten once we have >=3 real runs to calibrate from.
